name: hidden
purpose: Occlusion culling (G3d): a wall across the way hides 64 copies of a 100,000-triangle clustered torus; 8 more stand in front of it. 'occluded' looks at the wall (the best case: all 64 behind it), 'peek' from beside it (some show past its end, the rest stay hidden), 'open' from behind the grid (nothing is hidden by the wall: the cost of the test alone). No Cycles truth: pictures are judged against the same scene without occlusion culling. Run with --lod-occlusion; the scene turns levels, clusters and the GPU cut on itself.
